method: Every contact-sheet page viewed in timeline order; 2 fps samples across each complete artifact. The 1655 pilot also reviewed at 4 fps. This is sampled screening, not inspection of every raw frame.
scope: Visual-only, one application. No media redistribution or training permission asserted. Internal implementation requirements are grounded in the accompanying issue text and oracle, not inferred from pixels alone.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1557.text: Morphing a data store outside a pool to a data object produces an error. The replacement menu should prevent an invalid reference outside the pool.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1567.text: After wrapping a process in a pool and entering a subprocess, clicking the parent breadcrumb fails to return to the root. Navigation should follow the changed root.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1570.text: Wrapping the process in a pool makes the diagram jump in the viewport. The current scroll and zoom should be preserved, including undo and redo.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1578.text: After copying a pool containing a task, exporting and importing the diagram produces errors. Copying must create distinct process identities and correctly connected diagram information.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1610.text: An active text editing box remains visible after leaving the subprocess plane. Changing the root should finish editing the previous element.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1623.text: After switching diagrams and returning, the subprocess drilldown overlay disappears. Subprocess navigation should remain available after reopening the diagram.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1638.text: Clearing a task label triggers linting errors. Clearing the name should remove its label information rather than leave a null label property.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1655.text: After setting an external label to orange, its text uses the pale fill color rather than the darker stroke color. External label text should use the stroke color.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1659.text: Resizing an expanded subprocess reroutes its sequence flow while the label and attached association remain behind. Labels and associations should follow the updated connection.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1677.text: Removing an element with direct editing active leaves an editing box behind and breaks the interaction. Removing the selected element should cancel direct editing.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1679.text: Switching a task from loop to parallel or sequential changes its marker but leaves the exported XML loop type unchanged. The selected loop characteristics must be serialized correctly.

bpmn-io__bpmn-js-1719.text: Collapsing an expanded subprocess leaves internal event labels visible outside it. Labels belonging to the subprocess should move to its hidden plane.
